Torras Pstand Series Case for iPhone 16 Plus (Titanium gray)

The Torras Pstand case for iPhone 16 Plus features a magnetic design and offers a stable stand for comfort and protection of your device. It also enables fast wireless charging, and compatibility with magnetic accessories enhances its functionality.

Stability and security

The practical stand guarantees stability when using the phone. The solution used is particularly useful when watching movies and video conferencing. Thanks to MegaMag™ technology and N56 magnets, the case is great for traveling and reliably stays in place even on uneven surfaces, making it easier to use navigation applications.

High quality manufacturing

Pleasant-to-the-touch materials were used for the Torras Pstand case, which provide a secure grip, minimizing the risk of the phone slipping out of your hand. Precisely made cutouts allow comfortable use of all functions. The accessory also prevents the device from overheating during heavy use.

Protection against drops

Thanks to X-Shock™ technology and multi-layer construction, the case provides four times higher drop resistance compared to standard products. The product offers military-grade (Mil-Grade) protection against falls from heights of up to about 3.6 meters. The 360° Airbag technology guarantees full protection of the phone's edge, absorbing shocks and minimizing the risk of damage. In addition, the raised edge further protects the lens.

SHOPITEM.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Subwoofer Edifier Airpulse SW8 (čierny) Edifier SW8 je subwoofer, ktorý posunie váš zvukový zážitok na novú úroveň. Vytvoril ho renomovaný odborník na zvuk Phil Jones a bude ideálny pre hudobné…
SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
Subwoofer Edifier Airpulse SW8 (čierny)

Edifier SW8 je subwoofer, ktorý posunie váš zvukový zážitok na novú úroveň. Vytvoril ho renomovaný odborník na zvuk Phil Jones a bude ideálny pre hudobné zostavy 2.1 aj systémy domáceho kina. SW8 je subwoofer, ktorý prekvapí svojím výkonom a presnosťou zvuku, pričom ponúka jednoduchú integráciu s ostatnými zariadeniami a elegantný dizajn. Je ideálnou voľbou pre každého milovníka vynikajúceho zvuku.

Bezproblémová integrácia s aktívnymi reproduktormi Airpulse

SW8 je harmonickým doplnkom vášho audio systému. Dokonale spolupracuje s aktívnymi reproduktormi Airpulse A80, A100 a SM200 a vytvára dynamickú zvukovú harmóniu. Spoločne poskytujú plné zvukové spektrum, v ktorom je cítiť aj počuť každý tón, vďaka čomu bude váš hudobný zážitok ešte viac pohlcujúci.

Silný výkon a presnosť

Vďaka 8-palcovému aktívnemu reproduktoru a výkonnému zosilňovaču triedy D poskytuje SW8 silné, hlboké basy so špičkovým výkonom 170 W. Analógový predzosilňovač poskytuje presný a čistý zvuk, ktorý upúta vašu pozornosť a umožní vám naplno sa ponoriť do hudby a filmov.

Prispôsobenie zvuku

Model SW8 ponúka možnosť prispôsobiť zvuk vašim potrebám nastavením zosilnenia, dolnopriepustného filtra a fázy. Tieto funkcie umožňujú, aby boli basové frekvencie v dokonalej harmónii s reproduktormi a vytvorili tak ucelenú a zladenú zvukovú atmosféru dokonale prispôsobenú vašej miestnosti.

Univerzálna kompatibilita

Subwoofer SW8 bez problémov spolupracuje so štandardnými receivermi domáceho kina vďaka vstupom RCA linkovej úrovne/LFE. Vďaka tomu je integrácia do vášho audio systému jednoduchá a bezproblémová, pričom je zabezpečená najvyššia kvalita zvuku.

Vynikajúci dizajn

SW8 nie je len o výkonnom zvuku, ale aj o elegantnom dizajne. Jeho moderný dizajn dokonale zapadne do každého interiéru a dodá mu nádych elegancie.

SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
Torras Ostand Pro Case for iPhone 16 (Transparent)

TORRAS Ostand Pro is a case designed with your iPhone 16 in mind that provides unparalleled protection. Created with scratch- and damage-resistant materials, it effectively protects your phone from everyday hazards. Raised edges of 2.5mm around the camera and 1.5mm around the screen provide an extra layer of protection to keep your iPhone safe from scratches and damage. So you can put your phone on a variety of surfaces without worry, knowing that its most delicate parts are properly protected.

No more fingerprints

Using innovative Tora-Smooth technology, the TORRAS Ostand Pro case prevents fingerprints by keeping the back of your phone smooth and clean. No more annoying smudges - from now on, your iPhone will always look pristine, no matter how often you use it.

Multifunctional ring

The built-in ring in the TORRAS Ostand Pro case serves a dual role. You can use it as a comfortable grip to hold your phone securely in any situation, minimizing the risk of accidentally dropping it. In addition, the ring serves as a functional stand that allows you to position your phone at the perfect angle for watching videos, making video calls or taking photos. The 360° rotation and precision mechanism make every angle change smooth and stable.

Magnetic mounting and fast charging

The TORRAS Ostand Pro is designed to be compatible with MagSafe accessories, ensuring a strong and secure attachment. The perfect fit with magnetic car mounts and desktop accessories ensures that your iPhone stays in place, even on rough roads. In addition, the case supports fast and seamless wireless charging, so you can charge your phone without removing it from the case.

ModelOstand Pro
ColorTransparent

SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
Puzdro Torras Ostand R Fusion pre iPhone 16 Pro (čierne)

Puzdro TORRAS Ostand R Fusion je navrhnuté na maximálnu ochranu vášho iPhone 16 Pro. Je vyrobené z odolných materiálov a poskytuje účinnú ochranu pred pádmi, poškriabaním a iným poškodením. Jeho tenký dizajn nepridáva telefónu zbytočný objem, takže si zachováva svoju pôvodnú siluetu a zároveň je plne chránený.

Pohodlie v akejkoľvek polohe - 360° rotácia

Vďaka inovatívnemu dizajnu krúžku otočného o 360° ponúka puzdro TORRAS Ostand R Fusion bezkonkurenčné pohodlie. Telefón môžete polohovať v akomkoľvek uhle, vďaka čomu je sledovanie videí, videohovory alebo prehliadanie internetu ešte pohodlnejšie. Táto funkcia vám tiež umožňuje držať telefón bezpečne v ruke, čím sa znižuje riziko jeho náhodného pádu.

Magnetické uchopenie

Puzdro je vybavené silnými magnetmi, ktoré poskytujú stabilné pripevnenie k držiakom do auta aj k inému magnetickému príslušenstvu. Telefón môžete bez obáv používať počas jazdy autom, cvičenia na stacionárnom bicykli alebo len tak relaxovať so zariadením v ruke - silný magnet zabezpečí, že telefón zostane na svojom mieste bez ohľadu na podmienky.

SHOPITEM.NAME: Parná kefa pre mačky Rojeco s masážnou funkciou (biela)
SHOPITEM.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Parná kefa pre mačky Rojeco s masážnou funkciou (biela) Poskytnite svojmu milovanému domácemu miláčikovi komplexnú starostlivosť a pohodlie. Kefa na úpravu srsti Rojeco ponúka funkciu automatického…
SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
Parná kefa pre mačky Rojeco s masážnou funkciou (biela)

Poskytnite svojmu milovanému domácemu miláčikovi komplexnú starostlivosť a pohodlie. Kefa na úpravu srsti Rojeco ponúka funkciu automatického rozprašovania pary a umožňuje vykonávať jemnú masáž. Okrem toho generuje záporné ióny. Vďaka tomu poteší majiteľov mačiek a menších a stredne veľkých psov, ktorí sa chcú postarať o zdravie a vzhľad srsti svojho domáceho maznáčika. Vďaka kompaktným rozmerom a bezdrôtovému napájaniu možno zariadenie pohodlne používať doma aj na cestách. Výrobok spĺňa prísne normy kvality a bezpečnosti, čo potvrdzujú medzinárodné certifikáty, ako sú CE, RoHS a FCC.

Funkcia rozprašovania pary

Kefa využíva vysokotlakovú parnú rozprašovaciu dýzu na rovnomerné a jemné zvlhčenie vlasov. Použitý mechanizmus aktivujete jediným tlačidlom. Nádržku na vodu s objemom 34 ml môžete ľahko naplniť. Odteraz bude váš domáci miláčik vyzerať vždy sviežo a upravene!

Ionizácia pre zdravú a lesklú srsť

Použitie záporných iónov vám umožní profesionálne upraviť srsť vášho domáceho maznáčika bez toho, aby ste museli opustiť dom. Záporné ióny pomáhajú vyhladiť srsť a dodať jej prirodzený lesk, pričom zabraňujú elektrizovaniu. Výsledkom je, že srsť vášho domáceho maznáčika bude upravenejšia a zdravšia. Na úpravu srsti domácich zvierat je možné použiť aj esenciálny olej. Doprajte svojmu štvornohému priateľovi domáce kúpele!

Pohodlné česanie

Kefa Rojeco je vybavená 140° zahnutými oceľovými, na koncoch zaoblenými zubami. Jemne kĺžu po srsti, účinne ju rozčesávajú a nadvihujú. Zároveň sú odolné, takže vám výrobok bude slúžiť dlhý čas. Vďaka nim každý ťah kefy pôsobí ako jemná masáž, ktorá nielen uvoľňuje pokožku vášho domáceho maznáčika, ale tiež podporuje krvný obeh, čím poskytuje vášmu domácemu miláčikovi pohodlie a relaxáciu počas starostlivosti.

Jednoduché čistenie pomocou jediného tlačidla.

Čistenie kefy pre vás nebude náročné vďaka inovatívnemu systému odstraňovania chlpov - stačí stlačiť tlačidlo a všetky nazbierané chlpy sa od kefy ľahko oddelia. Vďaka tomu je čistenie po česaní rýchle a hygienické.

Pohodlné nabíjanie cez USB

Batéria s kapacitou 250 mAh poskytla približne 80 minút používania na jedno nabitie. Port USB umožňuje pohodlne obnoviť energiu pomocou notebooku, počítača, powerbanky alebo sieťovej zásuvky - tento proces bude trvať približne 70 minút.

SHOPITEM.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Neewer wide angle lens for Sony ZV1 (black) The Neewer 2-in-1 Wide Angle Lens for Sony ZV1 turns a standard 24mm lens into an 18mm lens, allowing for a wider angle of view. This is ideal for those…
SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
Neewer wide angle lens for Sony ZV1 (black)

The Neewer 2-in-1 Wide Angle Lens for Sony ZV1 turns a standard 24mm lens into an 18mm lens, allowing for a wider angle of view. This is ideal for those who want to capture more detail in the frame, which is especially useful when shooting landscapes, architecture or large groups of people. To get the full benefits, the lens should be used together with a macro lens.

Macro close-ups at the highest level

Turn your standard photos into detailed macro shots by transforming the original ZV1 lens into a 10x macro lens. Simply unscrew the wide-angle lens counterclockwise to use the macro lens itself. This is perfect for those who want to capture the smallest details up close, such as insects, plants or other small objects.

Professional extension for perfect quality

The built-in spring in the extension tube makes it an ideal choice for macro photography. By moving the conversion lens away from the camera sensor, it is possible to achieve higher magnification without compromising image quality. It is an indispensable tool for professionals who expect the highest quality macro photography.

High-quality optical glass and nano coating

The Neewer lens is characterized by the use of high-quality optical glass and a multi-layer nano coating, which restores natural colors and eliminates noise. The lens frame is made of anodized aluminum and precision-machined using CNC technology to ensure a perfect fit with the original lens. The coatings reduce glare and internal reflections for high-resolution images.

Ease of use and mobility

Mounting the lens is extremely easy. Simply attach the bayonet mount to the ZV1 camera and tighten it with the included L-shaped allen wrench. Then attach the extension tube to the mount and screw the lens onto the tube. A handy carrying case is also included for easy storage and transportation of the lens.

Included

  • Lens
  • Cover
  • Extension tube with built-in spring

Neewer softbox 85 cm

The Neewer Hexadecagon softbox with a diameter of 85 cm is a tool for photographers who want perfect soft light, ideal for portraits, product shots, fashion and other styles of photography. The deep parabolic design with internal silver coating disperses light evenly, maintaining a neutral color rendering index (CRI) and temperature, resulting in a natural look for your subjects. With two layers of diffusers, you can effectively soften the light and eliminate unwanted shadows.

Quick installation and durable construction

Thanks to its 16 sturdy ribs, the softbox provides unparalleled durability and a perfect parabola shape that won't deform even after years of heavy use. The quick unfold mechanism allows the softbox to fully unfold in less than 15 seconds, without the need for tools. When folded, it weighs only 1.5 kg, making it easy to store and transport in the included bag.

Modifiable grid and diffusers for even better light control

The Neewer softbox features a honeycomb grid that focuses light at a 45° angle, allowing for dramatic lighting effects that perfectly highlight the model's facial structure. It also comes with two high-quality diffusers that can be freely combined to achieve the desired lighting effect.

Compatible with Bowens mount

Thanks to the Bowens mount, this softbox is compatible with a wide range of studio and continuous lights such as NEEWER, Godox, Aputure, and other LED and flash lights, making it a versatile solution for a variety of photographic applications.

Easy storage and transportation

The kit comes with a large carrying bag, equipped with an internal mesh pocket, which allows for convenient storage of the softbox itself, as well as the grid and diffusers. This makes the softbox easy to carry and ideal for outdoor work.

Neewer 65 cm softbox

The Neewer softbox, with a diameter of 65 cm (26 inches), is an ideal tool for video makers, streamers and for interviews where even lighting is important. Thanks to its lantern-shaped design, it provides wide, balanced and shadow-free light with 360° coverage, an advantage over traditional square or parabolic softboxes. Plus, thanks to the skirt with touch fasteners, you can precisely control the shape and direction of the light, adjusting the amount of light to suit your needs.

Quick installation and removal

The product was designed with convenience in mind. Unlike traditional softboxes, it can be instantly unfolded and folded in one simple motion. It is also facilitated by an extended hook at the bottom of the design, which provides a quick and secure attachment. This is a solution that will save you time and simplify the lighting setup process.

Durability and excellent light quality

The softbox is equipped with 12 durable ribs that give it excellent durability and an unchanging lantern shape, even after many years of use. Thanks to its high-quality reflective diffusers, the softbox enables realistic color rendition and light temperature, which is crucial for professional photography and filming.

Standard Bowens mount

Equipped with a standard Bowens mount, the softbox is compatible with a wide range of LED and monolights, such as the Neewer CB60, CB100, CB150, CB60 RGB, and other devices with a Bowens mount. It's a versatile solution for anyone who needs versatile lighting.

Easy to transport and store

With a softbox weighing only 1.8 kg and folding down to a flat form factor of 65 cm in diameter, you can easily take your lighting anywhere. It also comes with a storage bag that makes it easy to transport and protects the softbox while traveling.

SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
Neewer 400 cm lighting tripod

The Neewer 400 cm lighting tripod is the perfect tool for professionals and photography enthusiasts who need solid support for heavy softboxes, flashes and Bowens-type video lights. With a built-in air cushioning system, it protects your equipment from sudden drops for safe and stable use during YouTube videos, live streaming, studio photography or broadcasting.

Easy height adjustment

The tripod features a telescoping center column with 4 sections that allow you to adjust the height from 140 cm to 400 cm. Robust locking knobs on each section eliminate the risk of accidental movement. The tripod can be folded to a compact height of 120 cm, making it easy to store and transport.

Durable and stable construction

The tripod is capable of holding equipment weighing up to 3 kg, making it a reliable choice for many photographic applications.

Universal screw adapter

The tripod is compatible with a wide range of equipment, thanks to a reversible, double-sided screw adapter with 1/4" to 3/8" threads. It allows you to mount DSLR cameras, mirrorless cameras, ring lights, LED panels, microphones and other photographic accessories.

Versatile mounting capabilities

With a 3-way mounting interface, the tripod allows you to place the mounting pin both vertically and horizontally, giving you the flexibility to position your equipment according to your needs. The locking knob ensures the stability and security of the mounted device.

SHOPITEM.NAME: TWS QCY MeloBuds Pro HT08 Headphones, ANC (black)
SHOPITEM.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: TWS QCY MeloBuds Pro HT08 Headphones, ANC (black) The QCY MeloBuds Pro HT08 headphones offer impressive stereo sound certified by Hi-Res Audio. They suppress up to 99% of ambient noise and offer…
SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
TWS QCY MeloBuds Pro HT08 Headphones, ANC (black)

The QCY MeloBuds Pro HT08 headphones offer impressive stereo sound certified by Hi-Res Audio. They suppress up to 99% of ambient noise and offer several ANC modes. In addition, they work with the case for up to 34 h and automatically stop playback when you take them off and resume when you put them back on. The touch panels, on the other hand, guarantee intuitive operation - conveniently use the voice assistant, answer incoming calls, etc. In addition, from the app, you can adjust settings, find lost headphones, use the sound equalizer, update OTA, or manage ANC modes.

Effectively suppress noise

Focus on what's important to you. The headphones adjust noise cancellation levels to the way you wear them, so you hear only what you want to hear. What's more, the advanced ANC noise cancellation feature eliminates up to 99% of outside noise, for a better audio experience. To activate it - hold down the touchpad on the right earpiece.

4 ANC modes

Choose the noise cancellation mode that's right for you. At your disposal are Indoor, which you'll use indoors, and Commute for traveling on a train, for example. In particularly noisy and crowded places, Crowd mode will work, and for wind noise reduction - Anti-Wind.

Sound that will delight you

Hear the previously elusive details of your favorite songs. The MeloBuds Pro HT08 use the LDAC codec, which enables data transfer rates of up to 990 kbps and guarantees richly detailed sound. In addition, the headphones provide stereo sound, which will make you feel like you're at a concert. The 12-millimeter diaphragm, on the other hand, is responsible for dynamic sound and emphasizes vocals.

Transparency mode

If you like to know what's going on around you, use the Transparency mode. You can adjust its intensity in 6 levels so that you can fully customize the headphones' performance. What's more, if someone wants to talk to you, the MeloBuds Pro HT08 will automatically emphasize your caller's voice and mute ambient sound.

6 microphones for high-quality conversations

The headphones use 6 microphones with ENC HD and AI technology to accurately record your voice and reduce wind noise. As a result, you can talk freely with your loved ones in a variety of conditions and rest assured that the other person will hear every word you say.

Up to 34h playback

You can listen to up to 510 songs on a single charge with the MeloBuds Pro HT08. With ANC on, the headphones last up to 7.5h, and about 8.5h when you're not using it. Together with the charging case, their running time is 30 h or 34 h, respectively. What's more, you gain 60 min of playback after just 10 min of charging.

Refined design

Enjoy comfortable use for a long time. QCY headphones are distinguished by their ergonomic design, so you can use them for a long time without feeling tired. What's more, they provide stability and won't fall out of your ears, and they weigh about 4 grams each - they will be almost imperceptible.

Stable Bluetooth 5.3 connection

The headphones provide a fast and stable connection without interference up to 10 meters, so you can use them comfortably. In addition, it is possible to pair the MeloBuds Pro HT08 with 2 devices at the same time and switch between them conveniently. On the other hand, the latency of only 80 ms allows for even better synchronization of audio and video - especially useful for games and movies.

Included

  • headphones

  • charging case

  • USB-A to USB-C charging cable

SHOPITEM.NAME: Neewer mount for Sony a7R V/a7R IV/a7 IV/a7S III/a1 camera
SHOPITEM.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Neewer mount for Sony a7R V/a7R IV/a7 IV/a7S III/a1 camera Universal protective cage for Sony cameras The NEEWER B0BP6FQXVJ is a versatile protective cage designed specifically for Sony a7R V, a7R…
SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
Neewer mount for Sony a7R V/a7R IV/a7 IV/a7S III/a1 camera

Universal protective cage for Sony cameras

The NEEWER B0BP6FQXVJ is a versatile protective cage designed specifically for Sony a7R V, a7R IV, a7 IV, a7S III and a1 cameras. Precision machined from black CNC anodized aluminum, this cage provides solid protection for your camera while keeping it compact and lightweight. Ideal for photographers, vloggers, live streamers and filmmakers, this cage protects the camera from damage while improving the quality of footage taken.

Secure mounting in two steps

Your camera can be easily mounted with the built-in 1/4" screw and further secured with an anti-rotation pin that is specially designed for the camera strap slot. For even more convenience, there is a magnetically stored 2-in-1 screwdriver under the cage for quick and hassle-free tightening of screws, ensuring the stability and security of your equipment.

A variety of mounting options for accessories

The NEEWER cage offers numerous 1/4" mounting holes that allow you to attach several accessories at once, such as arms, ball adapters, a small microphone or an LED light. Two cold shoe mounts and a 3/8" thread with ARRI locating holes allow you to connect additional accessories such as a top mount or field monitor.

Quickly change settings with the Arca Type base

The cage base is compatible with the Arca Swiss quick-mount system, allowing you to instantly mount your camera to a DJI RS 2/RSC 2/RS 3/RS 3 Pro tripod head or stabilizer. This makes it easy to switch between stabilizer mode for handheld filming and tripod shots.

Full access and flexible installation

With 1/4" threads on the bottom and sides of the cage, you can mount the camera on a tripod, monopod, handheld mount or slider in both portrait and landscape orientations. The cage provides full access to the battery compartment, ports and function buttons, allowing you to freely use the camera without removing the protection.

Dimensions:146 x 108 x 65 mm
Compatibility:Sony a7R V, a7R IV, a7 IV, a7S III, a1
Mounting type:Arca Swiss type base

NEEWER RH12B – 12-palcové vysokovýkonné LED krúžkové osvetlenie

LED kruhové svetlo NEEWER RH12B má výkon 24 W a je vybavené 180 vysoko kvalitnými LED diódami, ktoré generujú svetelnú intenzitu až 3290 lx vo vzdialenosti 0,5 m s farebnou teplotou 7000 K. Vstavaný difúzor rovnomerne rozptyľuje svetlo, čím vzniká mäkké, prirodzené a pre oči príjemné osvetlenie. Tento model je ideálny na nahrávanie obsahu pre YouTube a TikTok, živé vysielanie, líčenie, ateliérovú fotografiu, tvorbu podcastov, videohovory alebo produkciu profesionálnych fotografií a videí.

Osvetlenie prispôsobené každej situácii

Lampa je vybavená 90 LED diódami, ktoré vyžarujú teplé svetlo, a 90 LED diódami, ktoré vytvárajú chladnejšie odtiene. V režime CCT je možné nastaviť farebnú teplotu v rozmedzí od 2900 K do 7000 K a jas plynule regulovať v rozmedzí od 1 % do 100 %. Vysoké hodnoty CRI 97+ a TLCI 98+ zaručujú prirodzenú reprodukciu farieb. Používatelia majú k dispozícii aj 12 svetelných efektov, ktoré uľahčujú tvorbu profesionálnych videí a fotografií.

Stabilná konštrukcia a pohodlné nastavenie

Súčasťou sady je skladací statív z odolnej hliníkovej zliatiny, ktorého výšku možno nastaviť v rozmedzí od 54 do 180 cm. To vám umožňuje umiestniť svietidlo na úroveň očí alebo nad pracovnú plochu. Nohy statívu sa skladajú nahor, čo uľahčuje prepravu a skladovanie, a robustná konštrukcia zaručuje stabilitu pri každodennom používaní.

Sloboda nastavenia dokonalého záberu

Súčasťou balenia je guľová hlava so závitom 1/4 palca, ktorá umožňuje otáčanie o 360° a naklápanie o 90°. Vďaka tomu môžete rýchlo a pohodlne umiestniť svetlo presne tam, kde ho potrebujete. Toto riešenie poskytuje väčšiu flexibilitu pri fotografovaní, nahrávaní videí a živom vysielaní.

Súprava určená pre mobilnú fotografiu

Lampa je vybavená otočným držiakom na smartfón s ohybným ramenom, ktorý umožňuje otáčať sa o 360°, vďaka čomu môžete telefón používať v orientácii na výšku aj na šírku. Tento model je kompatibilný okrem iného s modelmi iPhone 16, iPhone 15 Pro Max, Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra, Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra a ďalšími mobilnými zariadeniami podobných rozmerov. Súčasťou sady je aj bezdrôtové Bluetooth diaľkové ovládanie, vďaka ktorému môžete fotografovať, nahrávať videá a vytvárať vlogy stlačením jediného tlačidla.

SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
Telesin handlebar mount for sports cameras

The Telesin handlebar mount is a unique accessory designed for sports camera users who need a reliable and easy-to-install solution for capturing perfect shots while driving. Thanks to its innovative quick release system and sturdy aluminum construction, this mount allows you to capture dynamic scenes with ease in any situation. Whether you're a cyclist, motorcyclist or using a scooter, the Telesin mount will give you complete stability and freedom of camera positioning.

Advanced quick release system

The Telesin mount uses an advanced quick-release system that allows users to quickly and easily switch between different environmental accessories. In this way, users can instantly customize the camera setup to suit their needs, without the need for complicated assembly. A distinct clicking sound during mounting and clear feedback enable easy and intuitive operation even without having to look at the mount, which is especially useful during dynamic situations.

Crab pincers-inspired design

The innovative crab pincers-inspired design of the mount ensures ease of installation and removal, making it significantly easier to use the accessory. The mount is equipped with soft, wear-resistant rubber inside the ring, which increases the clamping force and prevents the camera from moving while riding. This design makes the mount not only functional, but also extremely durable and resistant to daily use in harsh off-road conditions.

Dual-head ball design for complete flexibility

The Telesin mount features a dual ball head design, which provides extreme flexibility in positioning the camera at any angle. This feature is especially important for users who want to capture a variety of shots on the go without having to constantly adjust the mount's position. The ability to rotate 360 degrees allows for perfect frames from any perspective, making the Telesin mount the perfect tool for creative filmmakers.

Durable and lightweight aluminum construction

The mount is made of high-quality aluminum alloy, which guarantees its durability and resistance to mechanical damage. The aluminum construction is not only lightweight, but also very durable, ensuring the longevity of the product even under heavy use. This is the perfect solution for those looking for a sturdy, yet lightweight mount that does not put additional weight on the handlebars and does not affect driving comfort.

Multi-purpose mount for different types of vehicles

The Telesin handlebar mount is characterized by its versatility of use and can be mounted on various types of handlebars with diameters from 22 to 38 mm and from 9 to 15 mm with an additional rubber pad. This feature makes the mount compatible with a wide range of vehicles, including bicycles, motorcycles, scooters and other vehicles with similar specifications, making it the perfect accessory for any active lifestyle enthusiast.

SHOPITEM.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Ionizačná kefa na úpravu vlasov ANLAN 05-AZFS41-02A Ionizačná kefa na úpravu vlasov ANLAN 05-AZFS41-02A je moderný prístroj, ktorý v sebe spája funkcie úpravy a starostlivosti o vlasy. Pomocou…
SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
Ionizačná kefa na úpravu vlasov ANLAN 05-AZFS41-02A

Ionizačná kefa na úpravu vlasov ANLAN 05-AZFS41-02A je moderný prístroj, ktorý v sebe spája funkcie úpravy a starostlivosti o vlasy. Pomocou ionizačnej technológie kefa nielen uhladzuje vlasy, ale aj redukuje statickú elektrinu, takže pramene sú hladké, lesklé a plné zdravého lesku. Je ideálna pre tých, ktorí hľadajú účinnú a rýchlu úpravu vlasov, či už doma alebo na cestách.

Tri úrovne teploty

Kefa ANLAN ponúka tri úrovne teploty (160 °C, 180 °C, 200 °C), vďaka čomu si môžete zariadenie prispôsobiť svojim individuálnym potrebám. Či už máte jemné a krehké vlasy, alebo husté a ťažko upraviteľné pramene, kefa poskytuje optimálnu teplotu na úpravu vlasov. Takto môžete dosiahnuť požadovaný efekt v krátkom čase bez toho, aby ste vlasy vystavili poškodeniu spojenému s nadmernou teplotou.

Výkonná batéria

Ionizačná kefa ANLAN je vybavená dobíjacou batériou s kapacitou 4500 mAh, ktorá zaručuje dlhé používanie. Po úplnom nabití môže zariadenie fungovať viac ako 45 minút, takže je ideálne na rýchly styling počas ranného zhonu. Čas nabíjania je približne 2 hodiny, takže nemusíte dlho čakať, aby ste si mohli opäť užiť pohodlie používania. Kefa je navyše dostatočne kompaktná, takže sa skvele hodí aj na cestovanie.

Ionizácia pre hladké a lesklé vlasy

Vďaka technológii ionizácie pomáha kefa ANLAN znižovať statickú elektrinu na vlasoch. Produkované ióny neutralizujú kladné elektrické náboje, ktoré spôsobujú krepatenie a nekontrolovateľné strapatenie vlasov. Vďaka pravidelnému používaniu zariadenia sú vlasy hladké, lesklé a ľahšie sa upravujú. Je to skvelé riešenie najmä pre tých, ktorí bojujú so suchými a ťažko upraviteľnými vlasmi.

Kompaktný dizajn a jednoduché používanie

Kefa ANLAN 05-AZFS41-02A má ergonomický a ľahký dizajn, vďaka ktorému sa veľmi pohodlne používa. Vďaka kompaktným rozmerom a praktickému dizajnu si ju môžete ľahko vziať kamkoľvek so sebou - do práce, na dovolenku alebo na víkendový pobyt. Ovládanie prístroja je jednoduché a intuitívne, čo vám umožní rýchlo nastaviť teplotu a začať s úpravou vlasov bez zbytočných komplikácií.

Telesin handlebar mount

The Telesin handlebar mount is a versatile mount designed for extreme sports enthusiasts who want to capture their adventures from different perspectives. With a sturdy design and easy adjustment, this mount provides stability and convenience for mounting sports cameras, panoramic cameras, as well as smartphones on bicycles, motorcycles and other vehicles.

Universal compatibility and wide range of applications

The Telesin mount is equipped with two interfaces: a three-tooth interface and a 1/4-inch screw, which allows for expansion with different types of cameras, including sports, panoramic and phone clips. This makes the mount extremely versatile and can be used in a variety of situations. Fully adjustable and stable

The mount's low center of gravity ensures minimal shake and a stable image, which is crucial when recording dynamic scenes on uneven terrain.

Durable construction and resistance to harsh conditions

The main part of the mount is made of reinforced nylon fiber, which guarantees reliable strength and resistance to mechanical damage. The metal parts are made of stainless steel, and their high corrosion resistance, confirmed by the 72H salt spray resistance class, makes the mount perfect for harsh weather conditions such as rain or mud. This makes it an ideal choice for anyone who values durability and reliability.

Ease of installation and removal

The Telesin mount is extremely easy to use. A single screw controls the entire mount, allowing for quick installation and removal. The design has been tested for more than 500 installation and removal cycles, confirming its longevity and reliability in use. Users can therefore enjoy the full functionality of the mount for a long time, without worrying about wear and tear or damage.

Telesin Magnetic Quick Mount Kit for Sports Cameras

The Telesin Magnetic Quick Mount Kit is an innovative solution for active people who want to capture their experiences from different perspectives without having to hold the camera in their hands. With strong magnets and a state-of-the-art mounting system, the kit offers quick mounting and dismounting of sports cameras, allowing you to freely create dynamic shots in any situation.

Exceptional magnetic strength and safe use

One of the key advantages of the Telesin kit is the use of strong NdFeB magnets, which guarantee a secure and safe attachment of the camera. The magnetic system is designed to prevent accidental detachment of the camera even when running or jumping. However, for maximum effectiveness, thin clothing is recommended to avoid reducing the magnets' adhesive force.

Versatility thanks to nano-viscose

The innovative nano-viscose material in the Telesin kit is a novelty that allows the camera to be attached to almost any smooth surface, such as glass, metal or tiles. This reusable nano viscose pad is easy to clean, allowing repeated use without worrying about losing its adhesive properties. As a result, the kit offers not only the traditional chest mount, but also more creative mounting options on other surfaces.

Quick mounting and easy change of perspectives

The Telesin kit comes with a magnetic base with two jaws, allowing you to instantly change accessories in just two seconds. This makes it easy to switch from a chest mount to a selfie stick or other mount without complicated assembly. Liftingový a spevňujúci účinok na pokožku

Pomocou technológie mikroprúdov a fialového svetla pomáha masážny prístroj ANLAN účinne spevniť a vypnúť pokožku v oblasti dvojitej brady a krku. Masážny prístroj ANLAN pôsobí nielen na zlepšenie stavu pokožky, ale napomáha aj vstrebávaniu produktov starostlivosti o pleť, ako sú séra a oleje. Starajte sa o svoje zdravie a zmeňte svoje stravovacie návyky s odšťavovačom AMZCHEF.

Inovatívna technológia pomalých otáčok

Odšťavovač AMZCHEF lisuje šťavu rýchlosťou 80 otáčok za minútu, čo minimalizuje oxidáciu a zaručuje čerstvosť. Proces prebieha bez potreby použitia nožov, čím sa eliminujú problémy s oxidáciou a vy si môžete vychutnať čistú a na živiny bohatú šťavu. Vďaka technológii nízkych otáčok vzniká aj suchá dužina, čo dokazuje vysokú účinnosť prístroja.

Bezpečné a jednoduché používanie

Odšťavovač je navrhnutý s ohľadom na celú rodinu. Je vybavený bezpečným, úzkym vstupným otvorom s priemerom 4,5 cm, ktorý zabraňuje náhodnému poraneniu detí počas používania. Jednoduché čistenie

Tichá prevádzka a inteligentné bezpečnostné funkcie

Zabudované inteligentné čipy chránia zariadenie pred prehriatím, čím zabezpečujú dlhú životnosť a bezpečné používanie po celé roky. Použitie nehrdzavejúcej ocele 304, materiálu PMMA a priehľadného krytu zabezpečuje vynikajúcu odolnosť zariadenia, uľahčuje monitorovanie procesu lisovania a dáva vám pocit úplnej kontroly nad zariadením.

SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
Nástenná nabíjačka pre elektromobily Besen BS20 22 kW

Besen BS20-BC-22KW je moderná nabíjačka pre elektromobily určená na široké spektrum použitia – od súkromných garáží až po veľké komerčné parkoviská. S výkonom až 7,2 kW v jednofázovom režime a 22 kW v trojfázovom režime poskytuje táto nabíjačka rýchle a efektívne nabíjanie rôznych typov vozidiel, vrátane osobných áut, elektrických školských autobusov a elektrických sanitiek. Vďaka rôznym bezpečnostným funkciám a starostlivo navrhnutej konštrukcii ju môžete používať pohodlne a bezpečne.

Jednoduchá inštalácia a užívateľsky prívetivé rozhranie

Nabíjačka Besen BS20-BC-22KW je navrhnutá tak, aby bola jednoduchá na používanie aj inštaláciu. Montáž na stenu alebo na podlahu je rýchla a nevyžaduje žiadne zložité náradie, vďaka čomu je zariadenie ideálne pre domáce aj komerčné použitie. 3,5-palcový farebný LCD displej poskytuje používateľom podrobné informácie o stave nabíjania a inteligentný čip umožňuje zariadeniu identifikovať rôzne modely elektrických vozidiel a prispôsobiť nastavenia nabíjania konkrétnym potrebám.

Robustná konštrukcia a odolnosť voči poveternostným vplyvom

Model BS20-BC-22KW sa vyznačuje vysokokvalitnou konštrukciou z nehrdzavejúcej ocele a hliníka, čo zaručuje dlhú životnosť a odolnosť voči mechanickému poškodeniu. Trieda odolnosti proti nárazom IK10 potvrdzuje, že zariadenie je odolné voči nárazom a poškodeniu, čo je kľúčové v komerčnom prostredí a vo vonkajších priestoroch. Stupeň krytia IP66 zaručuje úplnú odolnosť voči prachu a vode, vďaka čomu je táto nabíjačka ideálnym riešením pre vonkajšie použitie bez ohľadu na poveternostné podmienky.

Pokročilé bezpečnostné funkcie

Model Besen BS20-BC-22KW je vybavený radom pokročilých bezpečnostných funkcií, vrátane ochrany proti podpätiu, preťaženiu, skratom, prehriatiu a úderom blesku. Okrem toho systém RCD typu A a typu A+6 mA DC poskytuje ochranu proti úrazu elektrickým prúdom, čím ďalej zvyšuje bezpečnosť.

Energetická účinnosť a voliteľná konektivita

Nabíjačka Besen BS20-BC-22KW sa vyznačuje nízkou spotrebou energie v pohotovostnom režime, menej ako 8 W, čo prispieva k úsporám energie a zníženým prevádzkovým nákladom. Okrem toho nabíjačka ponúka voliteľnú konektivitu cez Ethernet, Wi-Fi, 4G alebo Bluetooth, čo umožňuje diaľkové monitorovanie a správu zariadenia. Certifikáty CE, FCC, CSA, RoHS a ETL navyše potvrdzujú, že výrobok spĺňa vysoké bezpečnostné a kvalitatívne normy.

Telesin multifunctional silicone mount for sports cameras (black)

The Telesin Multifunctional Silicone Mount is the perfect solution for extreme sports and active lifestyle enthusiasts who want to capture every moment of their adventure. Thanks to its innovative quick-mount system, this mount allows you to attach your sports camera to a variety of surfaces in no time. Made of flexible silicone, the Telesin mount adapts to a variety of shapes and sizes, ensuring the stability and security of the camera in all conditions.

Telesin quick-mount system

One of the biggest advantages of the Telesin silicone mount is its quick-mount system, which allows users to switch freely between different eco-friendly quick-release accessories. This allows users to easily and quickly change the configuration of their camera to suit different needs and conditions, without the need for time-consuming disassembly and reassembly. This is an ideal solution for those who value functionality and convenience of use.

Flexibility and durability

The Telesin mount is made of high-quality flexible silicone, which, thanks to its double hole, allows installation on surfaces of different sizes and shapes. Whether you want to attach the camera to a bike, helmet or selfie stick, the Telesin mount provides stability and security. Yeelight Ultra-thin Motion Sensor Closet Light A30

The Yeelight A30 Motion Sensor Closet Light is perfect for many applications. For example, you can mount it in a closet, by the stairs, in the kitchen or in the car to provide a reliable source of light for any occasion. It is very easy to install, and thanks to its 1100 mAh battery, it stands out for its long runtime. The device also provides a color temperature of 4000K, and allows you to freely adjust the brightness.

Choose from the available operating modes

The lamp supports two modes of operation - On and Auto. The first allows you to turn it on and off manually at any time. While the second allows it to work automatically - the device will spontaneously turn on the light when it detects motion. The range of the built-in sensor is about 33 cm, so you can be sure the A30 will work only when you really need it.

Optimum illumination in any situation

The lamp generates eye-friendly lighting with a wide 90° angle of incidence and a neutral color temperature of 4000K. This makes it great for most situations. You can also freely adjust the brightness of the light to suit your current needs. Ensure your dream comfort under any circumstances!

Long working time

Don't be afraid of having to charge the light frequently. The device is equipped with a powerful 1100 mAh battery, which provides up to 33 hours of continuous use or about 6 months of operation in Auto mode (assuming it will turn on 3 times a day at the highest brightness level). So you can use it for a really long time!

Easy installation

Mounting the light will not cause you any problem. The built-in magnet allows you to quickly and stably attach it to any metal surface. Do you want to use it in another place, for example, in a wooden cabinet? In this case, just use the dedicated adhesive plates! An additional advantage of the lamp is its thin design - its thickness is only about 0.7 cm. This means that it will be almost invisible under the cabinets and will not affect the interior design!

Many applications

Lamp A30 will prove useful not only in the cabinet. You will successfully use it, for example, as a trunk light in the car. You can also mount it in the kitchen to provide an additional source of light while cooking. It will also be a good idea to attach it near the stairs or bed to light your way at night when you go to the bathroom or to the child's room.

SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
GameSir K1 Flux wired controller

The GameSir K1 Flux wired controller is a piece of hardware that will meet the expectations of even the most demanding gamers. With its advanced technologies, customization options and excellent ergonomics, it provides an unparalleled gaming experience. If you're looking for a controller that combines modern design with top-notch functionality, the K1 Flux is for you. Improve your skills and enjoy gaming like never before!

Exceptional design and precision manufacturing

Authorized by Xbox, equipped with Hall effect sticks and analog triggers, the controller offers exceptional durability and precise response to every movement. The transparent housing with two customizable LED light bars allows gamers to admire the lighting effects running along the printed circuit board (PCB), adding visual appeal to any gaming session.

Reliable performance and comfort in every game

Thanks to the GameSir™ Hall Effect sensors, the controller ensures reliable and durable stick performance when playing console games. This technology prevents the sticks from drifting, ensuring consistent precision and control. The Hall Effect analog triggers offer consistent travel distance, providing a natural feel for the depth of pressure - whether you're accelerating in a race or braking. The controller is equipped with four vibration actuators - two in the grips and two in the triggers - that provide realistic and subtle feedback, taking the gaming experience to a whole new level.

Personalize and adapt to your playing style

The K1 Flux offers advanced personalization capabilities with GameSir Nexus software. It allows you to create individual controller profiles, map buttons, fine-tune sticks and triggers, as well as configure vibrations and lighting effects. The ability to save up to three profiles allows you to quickly change settings depending on the type of game. In addition, the software makes it easy to switch to Hair Trigger mode for FPS and action games, giving gamers an edge in the most dynamic situations.

Efficiency and responsiveness at the highest level

The GameSir K1 Flux controller is equipped with four ultra-personalized lighting effects that can be customized for different gaming environments, ensuring perfect brightness in any situation. Two assignable macro back buttons and a turbo function for the main buttons enable even faster and more precise control. With laser-textured grips and triggers, the controller provides a firm grip on the hand, preventing slippage and sweating, which is crucial during long gaming sessions.

Compatibility and performance

The GameSir K1 Flux works seamlessly with Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One X/S, Windows 10/11 and the Steam platform, offering smooth and top-quality gameplay with minimal lag. It's the perfect choice for gamers who value both precision and comfort while playing.

Pet Health Protection

Catlink filters not only purify the water but also soften it, which is particularly beneficial for the health of animals. The accessories remove calcium and magnesium ions from the water, which can contribute to the formation of urinary stones. Drinking filtered water helps prevent health problems in animals.

The process is smooth and hassle-free – after installing the new filter, simply hold the button on the device for 15 seconds to activate the filter and ensure it is working at full efficiency. SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
GameSir G7 HE wired controller (black)

The GameSir G7 HE is a wired controller that combines advanced technology, durability and convenience to offer gamers complete control and an exceptional gaming experience across platforms. With customizable controls, precise sticks and triggers, and superior ergonomics, the G7 HE is the perfect choice for any gamer who appreciates both functionality and style. Enhance your gaming experience with the GameSir G7 HE and enjoy gaming at the highest level!

Compatibility and versatility

GameSir G7 HE is a wired controller that is designed to provide gamers with an exceptional gaming experience across a variety of platforms. It is fully compatible with Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One X/S, Windows 10/11 and Steam platform, allowing gamers to switch seamlessly between different devices and games. With GameSir G7 HE, you can enjoy your favorite games without platform restrictions, giving you complete flexibility and freedom.

Unmatched precision and durability

The controller is equipped with GameSir™ advanced Hall-effect sensor sticks, which provide durability of up to 5 million cycles. These sticks offer precise and responsive feedback, and are equipped with wear-resistant rings to prevent damage to the hardware. Hall-effect analog triggers guarantee consistent distance and depth, which is crucial in racing games where precision acceleration and braking is of paramount importance. In addition, for FPS and action game players, the GameSir G7 HE offers an ultra-sensitive trigger mode (Hair Trigger Mode), which can be activated by holding down the M + LT/RT buttons.

Ergonomics and high build quality

The G7 HE is designed for gamers who value not only functionality, but also comfort and durability. Equipped with a tactile yet cushioned microswitch, the front buttons can withstand up to 3 million presses for responsive and clickable feedback. The character of the buttons is crisp and evocative of e-sports style, enhancing the gaming experience. Two separate motors in the grips offer powerful and subtle vibrations, while asymmetrical motors in the triggers deliver precise responses to every action, adding realism and intensity to any gameplay.

Personalization and self-expression

One of the outstanding features of the GameSir controller is its ability to be fully personalized. The magnetic function allows the front panel to be swapped for another, allowing gamers to customize the look of the controller according to their preferences. The paint-friendly front panel allows players to paint and decorate the controller without removing it, giving them the opportunity to express their creativity and style. In addition, extensive re-mapping support with almost every button on the controller allows for even more customization.

Excellent sound and convenient communication

The GameSir G7 HE is equipped with a 3.5mm audio jack that allows you to easily connect a headset for immersive sound and clear communication during gaming. An independent mute button allows you to instantly turn off the microphone, which is ideal for situations where you need quick privacy and convenience when interacting online.

The Zeblaze GTR 3 Pro combines art and advanced technology in one smartwatch. Zeblaze Btalk 3 Plus Smartwatch (Gold)

The Zeblaze Btalk 3 Plus smartwatch is designed to become your reliable daily companion. With advanced health monitoring features, extensive personalization options and precise activity monitoring, the Zeblaze Btalk 3 Plus will become not only a practical tool, but also a stylish accessory that fits perfectly with your needs and lifestyle.

A display that impresses

The smartwatch features a 1.39-inch HD color display that provides sharp images with a resolution of 360x360 pixels. The subtly curved 2.5D glass makes the screen look sleek and modern, while providing a clear, vivid image that is perfectly visible even in bright sunlight. The watch also offers the ability to personalize the watch face with more than 300 available designs, as well as the option to upload your own photos.

Your health under control

Take care of your health with the Zeblaze Btalk 3 Plus! The watch is equipped with health monitoring features, such as 24-hour heart rate measurement and SpO2 (blood oxygen level) saturation monitoring. The available sleep monitoring function will allow you to control the phases of your sleep and its length, so you can improve the quality of your night's rest. The Zeblaze Btalk 3 Plus also features respiratory training and women's health monitoring, helping you maintain optimal fitness every day.

Workouts tailored to your needs

Whether you're a runner, cyclist or yoga enthusiast, this smartwatch is designed to support you in any type of physical activity. With more than 100 available sports modes, you can easily tailor workouts to your individual goals and preferences. What's more, you can continuously monitor the number of steps, the number of calories burned and the distance traveled.

Seamless communication

Forget about missed calls or messages. The Btalk 3 Plus allows you to easily answer calls and manage notifications from your wrist. With Bluetooth, built-in voice assistant and app integration, your smartwatch will become the center of your communication.

Long runtime for uninterrupted activity

Forget about daily charging! The Btalk 3 Plus offers up to 14 days of standard use on a single charge, so you can enjoy your activity without downtime. On the other hand, during heavy use, you can enjoy its features for about 7 days.

Additional capabilities

Zeblaze Btalk 3 Plus is a versatile assistant for your daily chores. Thanks to the weather forecast function, you will always be up to date with weather conditions. The timer and timekeeper allow you to accurately keep track of time during cooking, workouts or other activities. The built-in music controller allows you to manage the playback of your favorite songs without having to reach for your phone, and the calendar and alarm will help you organize your day and not forget important events. In addition, the camera controller function allows you to take pictures remotely, which is perfect for capturing the moment without having to hold your phone.

Šálkový mixér AMZCHEF ZM5003-GA (sivý)

Prídavná fľaša s objemom 600 ml vám umožní vychutnať si lahodné nápoje aj mimo domova.

Intuitívne ovládanie

Bezproblémové čistenie

Udržiavanie mixéra AMZCHEF v čistote pre vás nebude náročné. Funkcia automatického čistenia jedným tlačidlom vám ušetrí čas. Jednotlivé komponenty môžete bez problémov umývať v umývačke riadu.

Výkonný motor a spoľahlivé nože

The Hohem iSteady V3 Kit Gimbal is a versatile tool that provides professional stabilization, superior lighting and convenience. With its long battery life and universal compatibility, the Hohem iSteady V3 Kit gimbal is an indispensable piece of equipment for anyone who wants excellent recording and shooting results in any situation.

Innovative technology and versatility

Equipped with iSteady 8.0 technology, this gimbal provides excellent stabilization thanks to its advanced 3-axis algorithm, eliminating all shake and jitters during recording. This device works well in a variety of scenarios - from daily vlogs and live reports to professional videos shot during travel or intense exercise.

Magnetic tracker and creative recording features

One of the key features of the Hohem iSteady V3 is the built-in magnetic tracker, which allows precise tracking of a selected object or person. The technology is based on hand movements, allowing easy control of the equipment - with just the right gesture, you can start or stop tracking, change from portrait to landscape mode, or turn off the gimbal. With Creative Studio in the Hohem Joy app, you can experiment with different recording patterns and techniques, such as panorama mode, dolly zoom, and timelapse.

Hohem iSteady V3 Kit is equipped with advanced lighting features that provide a maximum illumination of 110 lux. The side wheel allows you to smoothly control the brightness of the light from 4% to 100%, and the adjustment buttons allow you to quickly and easily change the intensity of the lighting, giving you full control over the end result.

Portability and convenience of use

The Hohem iSteady V3 gimbal features a lightweight, foldable design that makes it extremely easy to carry and will fit into any bag or backpack, and its handy design makes working with the gimbal convenient and precise. The built-in 205mm long pole can be extended, allowing you to capture a wider perspective and more people or objects in the frame. In addition, the detachable remote control can be used on its own or attached to the gimbal's handle, which simultaneously charges the remote, which is extremely convenient during long recording sessions.

Universal compatibility and long working time

The Hohem iSteady V3 Kit is compatible with various operating systems, such as iOS and Android, and supports live reporting and video conferencing apps. The device has a powerful battery that provides up to 13 hours of operation on a single charge, making it the perfect companion for long recording sessions. From now on, let nothing limit you.

Carlinkit CPC200-Tbox S Carplay&Android Auto wireless adapter

The Carlinkit CPC200-Tbox S is a wireless adapter that will change your driving experience. It allows you to wirelessly use CarPlay or Android Auto without having to connect your phone with a cable. The device runs on Android 13.0 and is equipped with a powerful Qualcomm SM6115 processor for smooth operation. With its compact design and easy installation, it is ideal for drivers who appreciate convenience and versatility while traveling.

Performance and smooth operation

The adapter features a quad-core Qualcomm SM6115 processor, which combines Kryo Gold and Kryo Silver cores clocked at up to 2.0 GHz. This, along with 4GB or 8GB of RAM and Adreno 610 graphics, makes the device run extremely smoothly, even when using more demanding applications. In addition, the device offers 64 GB or 128 GB of internal memory, which can be expanded by an additional 512 GB thanks to a TF card slot. The ability to download apps directly from the store allows you to customize the device for everything from navigation to entertainment.

Compatibility

The Carlinkit CPC200-Tbox S provides seamless operation for both iOS and Android users. The device is compatible with wireless CarPlay, which supports iPhones from model 6 and up, and Android Auto, which works with devices from Android 11 and above. This means you no longer need to connect your phone with a wire to your car - just make sure your vehicle supports the factory's wired CarPlay or Android Auto, and the adapter will allow for a quick wireless connection. The adapter offers auto-switching between systems to ensure smooth and seamless operation.

Multimedia features

The Carlinkit CPC200-Tbox S adapter is not only a convenient integration of the phone with the car system, but also a powerful multimedia platform. It allows you to play movies, listen to music and access a variety of applications directly on the car screen. You can enjoy popular streaming services such as Netflix, YouTube, Spotify and HBO Max, as well as social media applications such as Facebook and TikTok. What's more, the device supports a wide range of Bluetooth wireless accessories, up to tire pressure monitoring and OBD systems. This allows you to further expand the functionality of your vehicle, customizing it to your needs and preferences.

Connectivity and navigation

The device supports dual-band Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz and 5.8 GHz), as well as Bluetooth 4.2 and 5.0, allowing a stable connection to your phone and other devices. In addition, WiFi hotspot support allows you to access the Internet on the go. The adapter has a SIM card slot, so you can use the 4G network directly from your device. In addition, the built-in navigation system with support for GPS, Glonass and Beidou provides precise positioning so you can easily reach your destination.

Modern solutions and convenience

The Carlinkit CPC200-Tbox S has a USB-C port and a SIM and TF card slot, allowing you to expand your memory and use online features. Thanks to its adaptive resolution, the device maintains image quality in line with the car's original settings for a clear and easy-to-read display. In addition, the adapter is very easy to use - just plug it into the car's USB socket to start using its functions right away. With this adapter, you can enjoy the full functionality of your smartphone on your car's screen, without the need for cables.

Reliable sound quality in a compact format

Hohem microphone is an advanced audio solution that will meet the expectations of even the most demanding users. Thanks to its advanced technology and ease of use, this microphone is the ideal tool for live broadcasting, recording videos, interviews or creating music. The lightweight design and built-in magnets make it easy to attach transmitters and receivers, and its low weight (15 g each) ensures all-day comfort. Excellent sound quality and noise reduction

The Hohem microphone provides pristine sound quality with a 48 kHz sampling rate and 16-bit depth, which effectively eliminates background noise and delivers digital sound of the highest quality. Versatility and ease of use

Quickly charging the equipment with a USB-C cable (only 1.5 hours) allows you to minimize downtime and get the most out of your equipment.

Advanced features and full control

The Hohem microphone's TX transmitter can be used as a standalone recorder and allows local audio backup to a TF card for greater flexibility of use. The microphone also features a reverb mode that masks subtle imperfections and adds depth and warmth to recordings. The ability to adjust the microphone's sensitivity at five different levels gives you full control over the recorded sound, and a mute mode makes it easy to stop recording when needed.

Compatible with Apple and a wide range of devices

The Hohem microphone is officially MFi certified by Apple, meaning it is fully compatible with iOS digital audio transmission protocols and charging standards. This ensures stable and reliable audio recording on Apple devices. A 3.5mm audio jack allows for the connection of an external microphone, further enhancing the versatility of the Hohem microphone.

SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
Catlink Fresh smart odor absorber

Catlink Fresh is a smart odor absorber that effectively eliminates odor through the use of ozone. It offers 3 modes of operation, allowing you to customize its operation according to your needs, and the durable battery provides about 8 days of operation on a single charge. In addition, 2 sensors (infrared and vibration) are responsible for the efficient operation of the device. In turn, the compact design allows you to discreetly place the canister in or next to the litter box, and the quiet operation does not disturb both household members and your pet.

Efficiency in removing odors

The Catlink CL-D-01 Absorber uses ozone technology, which effectively removes, not just masks, unpleasant odors. With this technology, it provides deodorization and disinfection of 98% and 99.7% respectively. In this way, it minimizes the risk of developing diseases and infections, ensuring healthy and clean air.

3 modes of operation

Catlink CL-D-01 offers 3 operating modes - Low, Medium and High - which allow you to adjust the intensity of operation to suit your current needs. In Low mode, the device can operate up to 8 days on a single charge, in Medium mode up to 5.5 days, and in High mode up to 4 days. This gives the user full control over the energy consumption and efficiency of the canister.

Automation and safety of use

The Catlink CL-D-01 odor absorber is equipped with an automatic ozone dispensing system. After 15 seconds of detecting an unpleasant odor by infrared and vibration sensors, the device releases ozone, effectively purifying the air. In addition, to ensure maximum safety, the device stops its operation during charging and when motion is detected, both human and animal, eliminating the risk of accidental ozone release.

It also allows wireless charging, which further enhances its functionality.

GaN technology for faster and more efficient charging

The BlitzWolf BW-S28 uses GaN (gallium nitride) technology for greater energy efficiency and better heat dissipation. As a result, the charger not only charges your devices quickly, but also maintains a low temperature during operation, prolonging its life and making it safer to use. The solution used also made it possible to reduce the size of the product.

High output power and support for fast charging

The charger's USB-C1 port offers a maximum output power of 140 watts, which means you can easily charge even the most demanding devices, including laptops and tablets. What's more, the product supports various fast charging standards, such as PD3.1, QC4+, PD3.0, QC3.0, QC2.0, PPS and SCP, for example. This way you don't have to wait too long until your devices are ready to work again!

Simultaneous charging of five devices

Forget about having to wait until one device is charged before plugging in another! An additional advantage of the BW-S28 is its wide compatibility. With its help you can easily charge most popular models of laptops, smartphones, tablets, headphones, portable game consoles and much more.

Digital display and easy operation

The BlitzWolf BW-S28 charger is equipped with an intuitive digital display that shows the current voltage and amperage for each port, giving you full control over the charging process. What's more, a touch-sensitive button allows you to turn the display on and off, which is convenient especially during nighttime use.

Wireless charging

Complete safety and protection for your devices

The BW-S28 charger is designed for maximum safety, offering protection against overcurrent, overvoltage, overheating, overload, short circuit and overcharging. So you can charge your devices without worrying about damaging them.

SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
Súprava na vysávanie domácich zvierat Oneisall LM5

Starajte sa o svojho milovaného domáceho miláčika. Súprava na starostlivosť o srsť Oneisall LM5 sa okrem iného skladá z vysávača, ktorý kombinuje funkciu kefovania, vysávania a zberu srsti. Pomocou nej účinne odstránite srsť a nečistoty a zároveň sa postaráte o pohodlie vášho domáceho maznáčika. Zariadenie ponúka sací výkon 10 000 Pa a nevytvára nepríjemný hluk (menej ako 58 dB). K dispozícii vám bude aj množstvo koncoviek vrátane tých na čistenie, vyčesávanie srsti a odstraňovanie podsady.

Sací výkon, ktorý zvládne každú úlohu

Motor s príkonom 300 W vytvára sací výkon 10 000 Pa, takže vysávač ľahko odstráni z prostredia chlpy aj jemné nečistoty. Tri prevádzkové režimy umožňujú prispôsobiť činnosť zariadenia typu srsti a individuálnym potrebám - od jemného vyčesávania až po intenzívne vysávanie. Vďaka tomu bude súprava dobre fungovať pre malé aj veľké domáce zvieratá.

Tichá prevádzka

Vysávač Oneisall LM5 je určený pre domácich miláčikov, ktorí sa ľahko stresujú, takže hladina hluku, ktorú generuje, nepresahuje 58 dB. Vďaka tomu bude ošetrovanie príjemným zážitkom aj pre citlivých domácich miláčikov.

Objemná nádrž a jednoduché čistenie

Prístroj je vybavený priehľadnou prachovou nádržou s objemom 1,5 l, ktorá umožňuje dlhšiu prevádzku bez častého vyprázdňovania. Priehľadné vyhotovenie umožňuje pohodlne kontrolovať jej hladinu. Vďaka jednoduchému vyberaniu a možnosti umývania filtra pre vás nebude údržba zariadenia problémom.

Rôzne koncovky v súprave

Súprava obsahuje 4 koncovky na ošetrovanie vášho domáceho maznáčika a čistenie. Rozčesávacia kefa vám umožní rýchlo a účinne odstrániť uvoľnenú srsť, zatiaľ čo kefa na podsadu zaručuje profesionálne výsledky a zbavuje vás odumretej srsti. Štrbinový nadstavec vám umožní vyčistiť ťažko dostupné miesta a čistiaca kefa je ideálna na odstraňovanie chlpov z nábytku, oblečenia a iných povrchov.

Úspora času a pohodlie

Súprava Oneisall LM5 vám umožní efektívne sa postarať o čistotu vášho domova a vzhľad vášho domáceho maznáčika len za 30 minút. Na rozdiel od tradičných metód starostlivosti, ktoré môžu byť časovo náročné a nákladné, vysávač s koncovkami ponúka profesionálne výsledky bez toho, aby ste museli opustiť dom.

Súčasťou balenia:

  • Vysávač
  • 1,5 m hadica
  • Kefa na vyčesávanie srsti
  • Kefa na odstraňovanie podsady
  • Štrbinový nástavec na čistenie ťažko prístupných miest
  • Čistiaca kefa na zbieranie chlpov z nábytku a oblečenia

High-quality optical glass and multilayer coatings

Vďaka tichej prevádzke prístrojov (50 dB) je súprava vhodná aj pre citlivejšie domáce zvieratá.

Zariadenie na úpravu srsti RFC-676 - spoľahlivosť a účinnosť

Zariadenie RFC-676 bolo navrhnuté na náročné úlohy. Je vybavený kvalitnými kovovými čepeľami, ktoré si dokonale poradia s rôznymi typmi srsti. Inteligentný LCD displej vás informuje o úrovni nabitia a pripomína vám, aby ste čepele namazali, čo zvyšuje pohodlie pri používaní. Batéria s kapacitou 2000 mAh poskytuje až 4 hodiny prevádzky. Nabíjanie trvá približne 3 hodiny.

Zastrihávač P20 - precízna starostlivosť

Zastrihávač P20 sa vyznačuje štíhlym dizajnom, ktorý v kombinácii s presnou špičkou umožňuje zastrihávanie chĺpkov v ťažko prístupných miestach. Vďaka 800 mAh batérii je pracovný čas zariadenia približne 120 minút. Proces nabíjania trvá približne 70 minút. Vodotesnosť IPX7 zaručuje bezpečné používanie a umožňuje pohodlnú údržbu.

Tichá prevádzka pre pohodlie vášho domáceho maznáčika

Strojček RFC-676 aj zastrihávač P20 pracujú mimoriadne ticho - vydávaný zvuk nepresahuje 50 dB. Nemusíte sa teda obávať, že by sa váš domáci miláčik počas starostlivosti o neho stresoval.

Strojček X2 je vybavený výkonnou čepeľou a nástavcami, ktoré umožňujú nastaviť dĺžku strihu. Kompaktný zastrihávač N5 je zasa ideálny na zastrihávanie ťažko prístupných miest, ako sú napríklad labky. Strojček Oneisall X2 - výkon a presnosť

Zastrihávač Oneisall N5 - precízna starostlivosť

SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
PetKit Purobot ULTRA inteligentný samočistiaci box pre mačky

PetKit Purobot ULTRA je inteligentná samočistiaca podstielka, ktorá kombinuje pokročilú technológiu monitorovania zdravia mačiek s komplexným systémom nakladania s odpadom. Je vybavený 1080p otočnou kamerou s umelou inteligenciou, automatickým systémom balenia a likvidácie odpadu a 10-litrovou nádržou, ktorá vyžaduje vyprázdnenie len približne raz za 20 dní. Zariadenie je zároveň plne bezpečné pre domáce zvieratá a eliminuje problém nepríjemného zápachu.

Monitorovanie zdravia pomocou kamery s umelou inteligenciou

Zabudovaná kamera AI s rozlíšením 1080p, ktorá sa otáča o 180° a ponúka 210° zorné pole, vám umožňuje pohodlne sledovať správanie vášho domáceho maznáčika v boxe na podstielanie aj mimo neho. Systém presne identifikuje každú mačku pomocou technológie rozpoznávania tváre, pričom analyzuje jej jedinečné črty, veľkosť tela a vzor srsti. Vďaka tomu je zariadenie skvelé pre majiteľov viacerých domácich zvierat! Okrem toho kamera zachytáva snímky výkalov a hrudiek, čo umožňuje včasné odhalenie zdravotných problémov. Purobot ULTRA tiež vytvorí podrobné správy o zdravotnom stave vašich domácich miláčikov - nájdete ich v aplikácii.

Automatické čistenie

Purobot ULTRA eliminuje potrebu manuálneho čistenia vďaka pokročilému systému. Po každom čistiacom cykle sa odpad z boxu automaticky zabalí, čím sa zabráni šíreniu baktérií a zápachu. Keď sa nádoba preplní, systém roztiahne vrecko, aby poskytol ďalší priestor na nečistoty. Navyše, keď vyberiete staré vrecko na odpad, mechanizmus automaticky nastaví nové. Už sa oň nemusíte starať! Venujte sa niečomu príjemnému a užívajte si ušetrený čas.

Aj 20 dní bez čistenia

Veľká 10-litrová nádoba na odpad vám umožní používať odpadkový box približne 20 dní bez toho, aby ste ho museli vyprázdniť. Vďaka tomu je Purobot ULTRA ideálnou voľbou pre zaneprázdnených ľudí, ktorí nemajú veľa času na čistenie. Dobre poslúži aj pri viacdňových výletoch.

Trojitá kontrola zápachu

Purobot ULTRA ponúka pokročilý systém kontroly zápachu, ktorý účinne eliminuje zápach. Špeciálne navrhnuté dvierka nádoby na odpad sa po každom čistiacom cykle automaticky zatvoria a neutralizačná kazeta s vôňou jazmínu udrží sviežosť až 60 dní. Zabudnite na nepríjemné vône v blízkosti odpadkového koša!

Tesnosť a bezpečnosť

Až 20 presných senzorov zaisťuje úplnú bezpečnosť vášho domáceho maznáčika. Systém okamžite zastaví prevádzku toalety, ak zistí prítomnosť mačky, čím eliminuje riziko zaseknutia alebo zranenia. Vylepšený valec navyše využíva riešenie ShieldBase, ktoré zaručuje úplné utesnenie a účinne zabraňuje únikom. Nebojte sa neporiadku!

Zdokonalený v každom detaile

Záchodová misa je vyrobená z odolných, vysokokvalitných materiálov a jej šošovka kamery je odolná proti poškriabaniu - nemusíte sa obávať, že ju vaša mačka poškodí! Zariadenie môžete tiež ozdobiť priloženými samolepkami. V balení nájdete aj dve rôzne sitká, takže Purobot ULTRA bude dobre fungovať s mnohými typmi podstielky. Navyše po vybalení steliva môžete jeho kartónovú škatuľu ľahko premeniť na tunel pre vášho domáceho miláčika. Ide o praktické a ekologické riešenie, ktoré vášmu domácemu miláčikovi poskytne skvelú zábavu!

SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
Colmi P71 smartwatch (blue)

With Colmi P71 you can monitor your health and fitness throughout the day. The smartwatch has a large 1.9" display that provides convenient access to all functions. The powerful battery provides up to 7 days of use. It offers more than 100 sports modes, and will allow you to take better care of your health - it monitors heart rate, saturation, sleep and menstrual cycle. It allows you to make phone calls, and thanks to its IP68 protection rating, you can use it without worrying about accidental splashes.

Large touchscreen display

The Colmi smartwatch is equipped with a large 1.9-inch IPS HD touchscreen display, which offers a resolution of 240 x 284p. As a result, the image is clear and easy to read, and operation is child's play. However, it doesn't stop there! You can personalize the appearance of the display by choosing from more than 230 available dial designs.

More than 100 sports modes

Do you want to take care of your physical fitness? Or perhaps you wish to improve your performance in your favorite sport? The Colmi smartwatch is an indispensable partner during your workout! It offers more than 100 sports modes, so everyone will find something suitable for themselves. Strength training, running, cycling or maybe karate? Choose your favorite activity or try something new! The smartwatch also monitors calories burned, heart rate, distance traveled, number of steps and more. Achieve your sports goals with Colmi!

Take care of your health

Colmi P71 will also help you keep an eye on your health, so you can react to worrying symptoms in a timely manner! The smartwatch monitors your heart rate 24 hours a day, allows you to monitor your blood oxygen saturation levels, and also offers a sleep monitoring function. This will help you better understand your habits, which will help you improve the quality of your sleep. Also at your disposal are breathing exercises and a menstrual calendar to track your menstrual cycle.

Stay connected to the world

With Colmi, you don't have to worry about missing an important message! Once paired with your smartphone, the P71 smartwatch will instantly notify you of all messages and notifications from the app,among others. Facebook, WhatsApp or Instagram. The device also allows you to manage calls - all thanks to the built-in speaker and microphone! You can successfully use it to answer an incoming call, dial a number from the last call log or add a number to your favorite contacts. See for yourself how easy it is!

Additional amenities

That's not all that the P71 smartwatch has to offer! The device offers the assistance of a smart voice assistant, so all you need is a simple voice command to check the weather or start the music player. It's also possible to control your smartphone's camera remotely, check the weather forecast, set alarms or even play games.

With comfort in mind

The smartwatch will be great for everyday use. Thanks to its lightweight design (39g), you can wear it on your wrist all day long without worrying about discomfort. IP68 water resistance means that the watch can accompany you almost always. It is unafraid of sweat, rain or accidental splashes. You can wear it without fear while washing dishes, working out intensively at the gym or even while walking in rainy weather.

Long working time

Are you going to the mountains or on a bicycle trip? Or are you facing a running workout? You no longer have to worry that the smartwatch will refuse to work when you need it! It features a 230 mAh long-lasting battery, which allows up to 7 days of operation on a single charge. On the other hand, the watch can last up to 15 days in standby mode. It will take you about 2 hours to charge it, and the magnetic cable you'll find in the set will make this task easier.

  • smartwatch
  • magnetic cable
  • instruction manual

SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
PetKit Pura MAX 2 PREMIUM inteligentný samočistiaci box pre mačky

PetKit Pura MAX 2 PREMIUM je inteligentná samočistiaca podstielka navrhnutá pre maximálnu hygienu a pohodlie. Je vybavený nepriepustným valcom ShieldBase, trojitým systémom dezodorizácie a presnými senzormi, ktoré zabezpečujú čistotu, minimalizujú zápach a sú úplne bezpečné pre domáce zvieratá. Jeho 7-litrová odpadová nádrž poskytuje až 15 dní bez čistenia - takže si môžete užívať ušetrený čas! K dispozícii je aj aplikácia PETKIT, ktorá uľahčuje používanie odpadkového koša a umožňuje sledovať návyky vášho domáceho maznáčika.

Vylepšený valec, spoľahlivý bezpečnostný systém

Vylepšený valec ShieldBase bol navrhnutý tak, aby zabezpečil maximálnu tesnosť boxu na podstielku. To znamená, že účinne zabraňuje úniku - nemusíte sa obávať neporiadku! Testy vykonané v laboratóriu spoločnosti PetKit ukázali, že zariadenie zvládne až 2 litre tekutiny. Pura MAX 2 PREMIUM tiež zaručuje úplnú bezpečnosť vďaka 11 zabudovaným senzorom, ktoré zisťujú prítomnosť mačky. Okrem toho zostáva vchod do záchodovej misy vždy otvorený, a to aj počas čistenia - takže váš domáci miláčik ju môže kedykoľvek bezpečne opustiť.

Bez čistenia až 15 dní

Veľká 7-litrová nádoba na odpad vám umožní používať podstielku bez problémov až 15 dní. Nemusíte ju vyprázdňovať príliš často! Je to ideálne riešenie pre opatrovateľov, ktorí chcú svojim domácim miláčikom zabezpečiť ideálne hygienické podmienky, ale nemajú veľa času na čistenie. Dobre sa osvedčí aj vtedy, keď sa vydáte na viacdňový výlet.

Trojitý systém dezodorizácie

Systém trojitej dezodorizácie odstraňuje nepríjemné pachy a udržiava prostredie svieže. Čistič vzduchu Smart Spray vyvinutý spoločnosťou PETKIT odstraňuje až 99 % baktérií vo vnútri fľaše, zatiaľ čo uzavretá odpadová nádoba a kazeta na neutralizáciu amoniaku znižujú zápach o viac ako 98 %. Takže môžete zabudnúť na nepríjemné vône vo vašej domácnosti!

Intuitívne ovládanie vďaka aplikácii

Box na odpadky je kompatibilný s aplikáciou PETKIT, ktorá ponúka úplné ovládanie zo smartfónu. Pomocou nej môžete sledovať zvyky svojich mačiek, ich hmotnosť a stav zariadenia, ako aj pohodlne meniť nastavenia a používať dostupné funkcie. Budete tiež dostávať upozornenia, keď bude nádržka na odpad plná - nemusíte sa obávať, že ju zabudnete vyprázdniť!

Všestrannosť a kompatibilita so štrkom

Vďaka dodávaným vymeniteľným sitkám je box na podstielku kompatibilný s väčšinou typov hrudkujúcej podstielky - vrátane bentonitovej, hlinenej, tofu a zmiešanej podstielky. Vyberte si štandardné sitko na väčšie granule alebo voštinovú verziu na jemnejšie častice.

Tichá prevádzka a pohodlné používanie

Zariadenie Pura MAX 2 PREMIUM pracuje mimoriadne ticho, pričom jeho hlučnosť dosahuje iba 35 dB. To znamená, že sa nemusíte obávať, že by vás v noci rušil alebo vyplašil vašu mačku! Prístroj sa tiež veľmi ľahko čistí - jeho jednotlivé komponenty môžete jednoducho rozobrať. Vďaka širokému vchodu, nízkemu prahu a priestrannému interiéru je navyše box na podstielku ideálny pre domáce zvieratá rôzneho veku a telesných typov. Pohodlne ho využijú mladé, aktívne mačky aj staršie štvornožce! Zariadenie môžete tiež ozdobiť pomocou priložených samolepiek.

SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
Superfire HZ01 UV headlamp flashlight

The Superfire HZ01 is equipped with a 395 nm UV LED, so it offers precise and stable illumination that can be used for a wide range of specialized tasks, such as checking original documents, identifying mold or technical diagnostics. The high quality of the UV light allows it to accurately detect details invisible to the naked eye, making it ideal for professionals who need a tool for working in a variety of conditions.

2 types of light: UV and white light

The Superfire flashlight offers 2 types of light that can be conveniently switched. The powerful white light is ideal for everyday tasks such as construction work, camping or cycling at night. The violet UV light, on the other hand, is suited for more specialized applications, such as mold detection or checking the authenticity of documents or banknotes. Switching modes is easy - just press a button to switch from bright white light to violet UV, allowing you to respond quickly to changing needs.

High quality and advanced features

The Superfire headlamp is equipped with a number of practical features that enhance the user experience. One of them is a motion sensor that allows you to turn the light on and off with a gesture. The flashlight also allows you to adjust the angle up to 90°, so that the light can be directed exactly where you need it.

Detection and safety with UV technology

One of the key strengths of the Superfire flashlight is its detection function using UV light. With a wavelength of 395 nm, the flashlight is perfect for identifying counterfeit banknotes, making it an indispensable tool in financial institutions or for those dealing in antiques. In addition, UV light is useful in detecting mold, which can develop on various surfaces, and in monitoring cleanliness in homes, workshops and other workplaces.

Robust design and comfort of use

The Superfire flashlight was designed with user comfort in mind. Equipped with an elastic head strap that can be freely adjusted, it adjusts to the size of the head, ensuring comfort during prolonged wear. The overall design is made of durable materials, resistant to harsh conditions, making the flashlight an ideal choice for outdoor work. The rugged housing protects the internal components from mechanical damage, and the water resistance (IP44) provides protection during rain or moisture.
